works.title: Cosmic Creation Parable
works.description: A philosophical parable about God and Son forging universes in a primordial workshop. The narrative explores the father-son relationship as the Son learns his craft through iteration, failure analysis, and creative refinement, with the Father observing the development of mastery through systematic improvement and careful analysis of previous attempts.
